sql:
SELECT a1.element, a2.element 
FROM atom a1, atom a2, bond b, connected c1, connected c2
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' 
AND c1.bond_id = b.bond_id 
AND c2.bond_id = b.bond_id 
AND c1.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
AND c1.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
AND c2.atom_id = a2.atom_id 
AND c2.atom_id2 = a1.atom_id
